'''Judy''' (Japanese: '''ジュディ''' ''Judy'') is a minor character who appeared in ''[[M09|Pokémon Ranger and the Temple of the Sea]]''. She is an [[Operator]] who works at a [[Ranger Base]].

==History==
[[File:Judy computer.png|thumb|250px|left|Judy on the computer]]
Judy helped coordinate {{OBP|Pokémon Ranger|Ranger series}} [[Jack Walker]]'s latest field mission, returning the {{OBP|Manaphy|M09}} {{pkmn|Egg}} to [[Samiya]]. She was first seen as Jack escaped [[the Phantom]]'s ship and continued to offer him insights throughout the movie.

Judy's past is unknown, although it is said she once was a popular idol before working for the [[Ranger Union]].

She is absent in the {{ma|Pokémon Ranger and the Temple of the Sea|manga adaptation}} of the ninth movie.
{{-}}

==Character==
Judy and Jack seem to have a familiar relationship with each other. They tend to engage in a bit of banter, though she remains focused on the task at hand.
